input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there

doc_friction.issue: --bets showed every bet (1-6) with no free, ungated ROADMAP item; about 20 minutes went to surveying payapps, jobshop-quote, residential-takeoff and seller-books before choosing a front-door page for the least-worked bet (#4).
The eCFR versioner API returns 406 unless curl sends --compressed (Accept-Encoding). Earlier fixtures did not say how they were fetched, so this had to be found again.

The 4 MiB per-category offline bound turns red when any venture in the category grows, so the merge that trips it is often unrelated (here a CMMC page PR). It took a custom gzip-by-venture script to find the cause; the test could print the top contributors when it fails.

deviations.why: Writeups: I extended the existing Level 1 customer post with an update section instead of starting a new post (consolidation, owner 2026-11-24).

notes: Security queue had no workable alerts and the ideas inbox was empty; routed to ventures. Built /cmmc/fci-vs-cui. Quotations come from fixtures: Part 2002 read from the eCFR versioner API (2026-11-01 point in time, compressed request) and saved under fixtures/cui with sha256 pinned. cmmc-site: node --test 95/95 passed. run_venture_tests cmmc: 0 failed. biome clean. A DoDI 5230.24 link was dropped because esd.whs.mil returned 403 through the proxy, so the page makes no claim about Distribution Statement A. After merging main for a conflict in pages.mjs (another run's SPRS submission page), the pages 'test' job went red on main's own content: PR #20062's SPRS guide had a 77-character title and a 174-character description, and the services offline bundle was 9.5 KB over 4 MiB. Fixed in this PR: shortened the title and description, and isNodeOnlyScript now leaves out *.test.mjs and a venture's root server.mjs (Node-only, imported by no page). The offline-bundle tests pass 12/12 locally.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing page (platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing), fetched 2026-11-12. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads are 0.1x input except 0.05x on Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 and 0.025x on Fable/Mythos 5.1 and 5.2. Sonnet 5.5 cache_read was 0.20 here until 2026-11-12 (quality audit round 48): records priced before then overstate Sonnet 5.5 cost.

human_equivalent.basis: researching CUI rules, writing a sourced page and its tests

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
